questions.question: Give the formula and one important use of hydrochloric acid and of sulfuric acid.
questions.expected_answer: Hydrochloric acid, HCl: in the stomach for digestion, or as pool acid / cleaning bricks / pickling steel. Sulfuric acid, H2SO4: making fertilisers, or as battery acid in car batteries.

questions.question: Classify SO2, MgO, NaOH, CO2 and CaCO3 as acidic or basic and give a reason for each.
questions.expected_answer: SO2 acidic (non-metal oxide); MgO basic (metal oxide); NaOH basic (metal hydroxide); CO2 acidic (non-metal oxide); CaCO3 basic (metal carbonate).

questions.question: Explain why carbon dioxide turns limewater milky, using the idea of acidic and basic compounds.
questions.expected_answer: Carbon dioxide is an acidic non-metal oxide and limewater (calcium hydroxide) is a base. They react to form insoluble white calcium carbonate and water: Ca(OH)2 + CO2 → CaCO3 + H2O.
